pages.text: The place of our first arrival seems to be remembered more deeply by the world. I used an Ender Pearl to imitate that mark, so a small patch of land remembers to let water flow and crystals grow even beyond my sight.

pages.title: Give the land a reserve
pages.text: Place it beside a charged reservoir, gather at least 100 and enable it with an empty hand. It first watches its own chunk; sneak-use the tuner to extend that watch to the surrounding nine.$(br2)Each chunk commonly spends 2 aether per second. Include production, storage and the resonance root, so the whole supply remains awake.

pages.title: Silence and waking
pages.text: When reserves run out, the anchor falls silent. About a minute after you leave this world, it also withdraws its mark and waits for your return.$(br2)After the world's long silence, a distant anchor may not yet be awake when you return. Visit it and let it catch the aether flow again; its watch will resume.
